content.title: HTTP calls to LLM APIs need node-fetch/axios because global fetch is missing
content.summary: On Node.js versions before 18 there is no global fetch; code calling LLM HTTP APIs with fetch() throws ReferenceError: fetch is not defined. Use node-fetch or axios as an HTTP client.
content.details: Seeded by the orchestrator as prior knowledge from an older project to exercise applicability checks. Node.js 18 made an experimental global fetch available by default.
content.tradeoffs: Adds a runtime dependency that is unnecessary on modern Node.

sources.title: Node.js 18 release announcement (global fetch available by default)
